reviews.text: My experience at this clinic was very good because my son's kitten fractured her leg, and we took her to three different veterinarians, but they charged too much. We didn't have enough money to cover the expenses, and thank God, this clinic performed the surgery, helped with part of the cost, and we hardly paid anything. I am very grateful to them.

Everyone is nice and helpful. They operated my dog and healed his hernia. I would of been happy if they had just removed the hernia and not neutered him. After being neutered he has no energy and doesn't want to walk. They said I had to but I honestly don't think it was the best idea. He seems depressed and different. It should be optional. They saved his life but killed his spirit. It hurts me to see him so different, makes me feel awful. I wish I had done something more to stop the neutering that completely changed him. I was afraid of this because I heard stories and it's very true. He's always had a healthy weight and lots of energy and happy. Now he's depressed, no energy and different. DO NOT neuter. You will regret it.
I probably should keep this a secret, but…. Fabulous vet and staff. Shhh don’t tell anyone.  :)
I don’t see the reason for the negative reviews and I’ve been going here since they opened and never had a problem what so ever, they took great care of all my pets from Cali, Oscar, Sasha and Ashley

Beware!!! They killed our 11 year old cat! Refused to give us his medical records and proper paperwork. Did not have a good reason. Blamed it on his heart but he didn’t have heart problems only bladder issues They told us he needed surgery and they required to keep him overnight but they didn’t inform us they do NOT have a 24-hour staff! Our cat died all alone. From what?? We don’t know how. They are negligible, dishonest and the entire facility is old and gross! Unfortunately, we are not rich and this was the only place we could afford. The vet didn’t even meet us once. No apologies were given. He didn’t care. They do not genuinely care about your pet. Watch out for their creepy vet assistant as well. His shoes were very dirty, he looked unprofessional and he had bad energy. Young guy with a bad attitude towards the front desk lady. If I can give you any advice…. Do not take your animal here.
Dr.Reina and his team are the best. They are caring, professional, attentive and kind. We are lucky that we found this clinic!

This place is the best pet clinic in all of LA they helped my dog with an emergency surgery she needed and they were absolutely wonderful all of the staff there were absolutely amazing they treated me and my dog Necee like family very professional and overall an excellent establishment thank you to the Doctor and the wonderful sweet 2 Nurses that helped my baby get better ❤️

Theresa, Valerie and the whole staff are phenomenal. I trust everyone at LA Pet implicitly, we feel lucky that we are able to have our pets treated there.

When I first arrived at this clinic, I honestly had my doubts about their service because of the building itself. I have a Chihuahua that I found in the street with a broken leg and a dislocated hip. I went to other vets and they charged me exorbitant amounts of money, until I was fortunate enough to find this place. Dr. Reina, Vanessa, and Jeison were excellent. My dog ​​had surgery a year ago and she's doing perfectly. THANK YOU SO MUCH FOR MAKING POSSIBLE WHAT I THOUGHT WAS IMPOSSIBLE.

Dr. Reine saved my Misty’s life by performing surgery on her. She is nine years of age and contracted a bacteria that would have killed her in a couple of days if left untreated. The staff was wonderful and treated her with care and compassion. I’m so grateful for all the work that they performed. It’s 16 days since the surgery and she is acting half her age. My heart felt thanks for all the help they give Misty.
